query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS total_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'admin') AS admin_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM access_codes) AS total_licenses,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM access_codes WHERE isActive = 1) AS active_licenses,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM access_codes WHERE usedAt IS NOT NULL) AS used_licenses,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_posts) AS total_posts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_challenges) AS total_challenges,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions) AS total_subscriptions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_history WHERE status = 'paid') AS paid_transactions;
